title: Execution with resource cost
statement: Given types of queries, answers, and outputs, and an oracle assigning an answer to each query, every deterministic query program evaluates to an output together with a cost triple. A pure output incurs zero cost; a batch of $m$ queries adds $m$ membership queries and $m$ units of local work; a charged computation step adds its specified number of units of local work. The random-example cost is zero throughout.
